entities.summary: Simone Eriksrud (b. 1970-08-21, Freiburg im Breisgau) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Freiburg im Breisgau and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
